messages:
Priya: Heads up — saw a sudden bump in schema_rejects for fncall in eu-west-1. Customers seeing 500s + odd billing entries. Anyone free to triage? :eyes:
Sanjeev: On it. any example payload?
Priya: pasted one from logs:
```json
{
  "error": "schema_reject",
  "hook": "fncall",
  "expected_shape": "object",
  "received": "["some","array"]",
  "route_id": null,
  "model_variant": "x-small-degen",
  "request_id": "req_01G..."
}
```
Lena: route_id being null is the billing issue — it buckets into the degen route. Did this coincide with the strict-validate canary?
Priya: Yes, strict mode flipped ~2h ago for fncall canary (strict=true, sample_rate=0.01).
Marta: Product: are these failing customer requests or internal rejects? We need to know before any rollback.
Evan: Telemetry: our reject sampling was low for fncall; also when payload is malformed we strip some metadata. Two problems: sampling hides scope, and missing metadata prevents grouping in console.
ops-bot: [ALERT] 7081235000 - schema_rejects(fncall) spike >5x baseline in eu-west-1. Ticket I-7081235000 created.
Sanjeev: Proposed quick fixes: (1) middleware fallback to reattach route_id from parent context before validation; (2) bump reject sampling to 10% for 6h; (3) revert fncall to soft-validate in canary until compatibility is confirmed.
Lena: Can we scope strict-validate to new tool bindings only? That avoids breaking legacy SDKs.
Priya: Support found two customers on older SDKs emitting arrays for that hook — they got 5xx. So it's a compatibility regression.
Evan: I'll patch telemetry to capture route_id/account_id on reject events and add a short-term alert comparing per-route billing deltas (>20% threshold). Also add console query for null route buckets.
Sanjeev: Hotfixing middleware now: attach route_id from request context if validation removes it. PR: github.com/redwood/inference/middleware#fix/fncall-routeid
ops-bot: [INFO] 7081235000 - middleware canary deploy started.
Sanjeev: Deployed to canary. Monitoring metrics.
ops-bot: [INFO] 7081235000 - middleware canary deploy succeeded.
Priya: degen-bucket counts dropping after patch. Switching fncall to soft-validate and increasing sampling for rejects so we can capture full payloads for debugging.
Marta: Keep soft-validate + higher sampling for 48h, then reassess. If telemetry is clean we can plan a smaller strict rollout with compatibility gates.
Lena: Long-term: define fncall compatibility policy and add console guidance mapping common validation errors to SDK versions/migration steps.
Evan: Filing follow-up task T-7081235000 for dashboard card (schema_rejects by SDK version) and telemetry retention.
Priya: Thanks team — closing the incident, follow-ups in ticket. :white_check_mark:
